what: nRF52840 Dongle running RIOT's own fido2_ctap_hid unmodified, the gated ladder of 13 stages that pinned the credential key to 2**44 - taken blind, with no debugger on the part and the key unknown to the analyst

victim.stack: RIOT's tests/sys/fido2_ctap_hid, unmodified, over the nRF52840's own USB
victim.build: upstream RIOT at the pinned commit; nothing added, no trigger pin, no console
victim.flash_acr: whatever RIOT leaves; the nRF52840 has no data cache at all
victim.table: RIOT's AES Te0, 1 KB, four-byte entries, declared with no alignment attribute
victim.table_addr: not read off this part: the ladder's own argmins put it at pad 4

geometry.note: pad 4 means the line of entry i is (i + 1) >> 2, so a collision is a shared 4-entry WINDOW rather than an XOR class. Same six bits of information, different algebra - and the constraint file the search reads can only express the XOR form, which is why host/constraints_from_campaign.py says in its own docstring that its diff6 values are valid at pad 0 only. The 2**44 figure comes from the window algebra, not from that file.

attack.expect_note: all 13 stages reproduce the delta class their record names, none of them does with the labels shuffled, and the weakest stage is 0.65 sigma
attack.note: A replay checks the MEASUREMENT half. The 2**44 search that turns these relations into the key is in ../search and is not run here: it is CPU-only Rust at about 3 Gcandidate/s, an hour and a half on ten cores. That is why this vector reports RELATIONS rather than a key, and why expect_recovery is false without the vector being a control - the demo README has the distinction.

truth.note: RIOT's cred_key on that Dongle, as the search returned it and as a captured credential's unwrap confirmed. It was NOT known while the ladder ran - that is what blind means here - and nothing in the replay reads it.
